  <!-- Meta row -->
  <g>
    <text x="16" y="316" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#1877F2">Draft saved 2 min ago</text>
    <text x="374" y="316" text-anchor="end" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#A0A3BD">384 words</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Title input -->
  <g>
    <text x="16" y="346" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66">Title</text>
    <rect x="16" y="354" width="358" height="54" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EEF1F4" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="28" y="387" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#050505">City council approves safer bike lanes downtown</text>
    <text x="374" y="387" text-anchor="end" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#A0A3BD">63/90</text>
    <text x="16" y="425" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#A0A3BD">A strong headline helps readers decide to open the story.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Article body -->
  <g>
    <text x="16" y="462" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66">Article</text>
    <rect x="16" y="470" width="358" height="180" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EEF1F4" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="28" y="496" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#050505">Yesterday, the city’s transportation committee voted 7–2 to expand protected lanes along Main Street.</text>
    <text x="28" y="521" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#050505">The project includes new crossings, curb extensions, and brighter signal timing near schools and the riverfront.</text>
    <text x="28" y="546" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#050505">Residents spoke about reduced congestion, safer commutes, and better access for delivery workers and families.</text>
    <text x="28" y="571" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#050505">Construction is expected to begin in early August, with the first section opening before the fall festival.</text>
    <text x="28" y="596" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#050505">Editor note: confirm the final budget figure and add two local quotes before publishing.</text>
    <text x="374" y="628" text-anchor="end" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#A0A3BD">7 min read</text>
    <line x1="28" y1="610" x2="362" y2="610" stroke="#EEF1F4" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="28" y="629" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#A0A3BD">Tip: use @mentions, hashtags, and line breaks for structure.</text>
  </g>

  <line x1="0" y1="670" x2="390" y2="670" stroke="#EEF1F4" stroke-width="1"/>
